author: Nintendo of America
description:
Easy Delivery Co. drifts onto Nintendo Switch on March 26: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/easy-delivery-co-switch/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1021-01&utm_id=P1021-01 

You've been hired to deliver packages in a once-scenic town, now plagued with storms and freezing weather. Earn well below minimum wage while chilling (literally) in your truck, battling against the rocky terrain and sky-high gas prices. Discover the story behind this village and its inhabitants, but don't worry—there's definitely no secrets here!
